verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a local iOS SSH/Mosh terminal client, not a hosted service with a server-side event stream, so subscribing to webhook events is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships registrable outbound HTTP callbacks; the docs cover SSH, Mosh, keys, themes, keyboard handling and VS Code connectivity, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
